items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...if you do it, Steven, and you do it, Teddy, Junior, and so many other people are doing this...

ctx.x: But the jazz sales and the classical sales are holding steady. But the pop thing is taking a big dive, But they are worried -- the top three companies are worried; they need that new gimmick to sell another gold record.

Perhaps.. since we got these young people -- we got to find some places for them to work. To get the -- change the concept of television programs and Broadway shows, if we've got these kind of young people coming out of these universities and doing these things, perhaps we can get some young writers to think along this line. This is my hope, this is my dream, as an old man -- for the preservation and continuation of jazz. If you do it, Steven, and you do it, Teddy, Junior, and so many other people are doing this,…
The Alvin Ailey Ballet is considering doing some things. They did one of Mingus's things.
